title: 第10章 她亲手布下第一张网
lines: 老太君的房里，灯火通明，却没有一丝暖意。
空气里弥漫着浓重的药味。
太医跪在床前，手都在抖。
“回相爷……老太君这次是真的不行了。”
一句“回天乏术”，像刀一样落下。
继母站在一侧，眼神却异常冷静。
她甚至没有去看床上的老太君。
老太君一死，府中权力彻底重分。
而苏晚，也会被顺势压回“废物”的位置。
却像针一样刺破了整个房间的死气。
依旧是那副安静得过分的样子。
content_zh:
相府的夜，越来越像一张网。

    每一盏灯，都像眼睛。

    每一个脚步声，都像试探。

    而网的中心，是苏晚。

    但没人知道，她已经不再“被困”。

    西偏院。

    夜深。

    风从破窗灌进来，带着寒意。

    苏晚坐在灯下。

    桌上摆着三样东西：

    一碗清水。

    一根银针。

    一张写满字的纸。

    纸上不是医书。

    是相府的“人名”。

    每一个名字后面，都标着两个字——

    “动机”。

    她看得很慢。

    像在复盘一盘棋。

    不是已经下完的棋。

    而是正在改写的棋。

    门外传来脚步声。

    很轻。

    但苏晚已经知道是谁。

    “进来。”

    门开。

    镇北王。

    他一身黑衣，气息冷硬。

    站在门口，没有进来。

    “相府乱了。”

    他说。

    苏晚没有抬头。

    “我知道。”

    镇北王看着她。

    “你做的？”

    苏晚终于笑了一下。

    “不全是。”

    她抬眼。

    “他们自己也很努力。”

    镇北王沉默了一瞬。

    “春杏的局，是你引导的？”

    苏晚点头。

    “我只是没阻止。”

    镇北王皱眉。

    “你在逼他们自乱？”

    苏晚轻声：

    “不是逼。”

    “是让他们选择最蠢的那一步。”

    镇北王盯着她。

    忽然觉得眼前这个人，有点陌生。

    不是“苏晚变了”。

    是——她从一开始就不是他以为的那种人。

    他低声问：

    “你到底想要什么？”

    苏晚停了一下。

    然后说：

    “答案。”
content_en:
The night in the Prime Minister's Mansion becomes more and more like a net.

    Every lamp is like an eye.

    Every footsteps was like a test.

    And the center of the net is Su Wan.

    But no one knows that she is no longer "trapped".

    West courtyard.

    Late at night.

    The wind came in through the broken window, bringing a chill.

    Su Wan sat under the lamp.

    There are three things on the table:

    A bowl of water.

    A silver needle.

    A piece of paper filled with writing.

    The paper is not a medical book.

    It is the "personal name" of the Prime Minister's Mansion.

    Behind each name, there are two words -

    "motivation".

    She looked slowly.

    It's like reviewing a game of chess.

    It's not a chess game that's already been played.

    But the game is being rewritten.

    There were footsteps outside the door.

    Very light.

    But Su Wan already knew who it was.

    "Come in."

    The door opens.

    King of Zhenbei.

    He was dressed in black and his breath was cold and hard.

    Standing at the door, not coming in.

    "The prime minister's house is in chaos."

    he said.

    Su Wan didn't look up.

    "I know."

    King Zhenbei looked at her.

    "You did it?"

    Su Wan finally smiled.

    "Not really."

    She raised her eyes.

    "They work hard themselves."

    King Zhenbei was silent for a moment.

    "Did you lead Chunxing's situation?"

    Su Wan nodded.

    "I just didn't stop it."

    King Zhenbei frowned.

    "Are you forcing them to cause chaos?"

    Su Wan whispered:

    "It's not forcing."

    "Let them choose the stupidest move."

    King Zhenbei stared at her.

    Suddenly, I felt that the person in front of me was a bit strange.

    It's not "Su Wan has changed."

    Yes - she was not who he thought she was from the beginning.

    He asked in a low voice:

    "What do you want?"

    Su Wan paused.

    Then say:

    "Answer."
title_en: Chapter 10 She laid the first net with her own hands
